title: Chapter 74
content:
Chapter 74

After arriving at the palace, I had a brief chat with the group of surrendered officials of the Han Dynasty. Carefully comforted them so that they could return to their respective homes with peace of mind.

Then, with the reason that they were tired after a day of driving and wanted to rest for a while, they dispersed separately.

As for the issue of rewards that they were concerned about, Zhong Yu also promptly stated that after a day or two, they would come up with a detailed charter.

They will definitely not treat them badly to the loyal courtiers of the Great Yu Kingdom. At that time, everyone will be rewarded, and even a few of the courtiers will be able to seal the country, Zhong Yu hinted.

Just like that, under the happy faces of the group of surrenders, they left the palace in panic, and each of them came outside the city gate whispering to each other.

Then the people who were close to each other went to the restaurants in the city to meet together, discussing excitedly what rewards they could get this time.

Seeing the unbearable performance of those surrendered ministers, Zhong Yu suddenly felt exhausted. If he also fell into the situation of Emperor Ling in the future, would anyone be loyal to him?

People who have exchanged their own system and are absolutely loyal to themselves, shouldn't end up like Emperor Ling!

However, the system, those who exchanged it, are they loyal to the system or to themselves! This question is still worth discussing, Zhong Yu is wise not to guess and entangle.

Now, I have occupied the center of the entire Han Dynasty, the hub used by the Han Dynasty to command various places and transfer resources from various places, and Luoyang City has been controlled by myself.

It can be said that all the people in the entire Han Dynasty no longer have their target of allegiance, and they can justifiably accept them in the name of their ancestor Lingdi.

I estimate that it only takes him half a year to send troops and horses to take over the cities along the way and wipe out those who try to take advantage of the fact that the big Han group has no leader and take the opportunity to cause chaos.

Then the entire territory of the Han Dynasty can be said to be completely under his control, and the world of the Three Kingdoms can also be said to be completely pacified.

However, this cannot be achieved perfectly. The purpose of coming to the Three Kingdoms world, in addition to luck points, is also a very important goal to have enough elite population.

I divide the elite population into three categories. First, the political type talents are specially used to rule the governance of their own territory in the main world of Kaituo.

Second, technical talents. Such as those various blacksmiths, medical craftsmen, and various craftsmen who are good at making weapons and armor.

These two kinds of talents need a lot of time for training and learning. I don't have so much time to spend slowly in the main world. It's better to plunder enough talents in the Three Kingdoms world.

The third type is an army that is sufficiently elite. It must be an army that has seen blood, killed people, and has been trained. And training this kind of army must consume a lot of resources, enough time, and a large number of people to fill the loss.

The reason why I recruited so many cannon fodder in the Three Kingdoms World is to use it to refine hundreds of thousands of elite soldiers. At that time, it is easy to use the Luck Points that can be exchanged directly to the system, and exchange them to the main world at a lower price.

Now the whole big man can be said to have no power to stop him, which means that he has no tough battles to fight and use to train more elites.

This is undoubtedly not in line with my goal, so I must find a way to let my army provoke a big war. Now that the Han Dynasty has been settled, there is no war, so I have to expand outward.

Who is the strongest barbarian around the big man now? Xianbei people? They occupy the big Han, the entire northern territory, and there are hundreds of thousands of people who control strings and armor. They have been harming the big Han in the north for decades, and they happen to be a strong opponent.

Only with strong strength can one's army experience enough severe wars, and can also train the most powerful army. It will be more practical to use it to fight against the tribes with extraordinary power in the main world.

Now that the future goal was decided, Zhong Yu felt more at ease, he was really tired after thinking about things for so long, and sat in the car for so long, so he fell asleep on his jade couch beautifully.

Three days later, Zhong Yu stood on a high platform on the site used for offering sacrifices to heaven in Luoyang City, overlooking dozens of rows of civil and military officials below.

Amidst their compliments, Zhong Yu slowly read out the articles on offering sacrifices to heaven written by those learned doctors from the Han Dynasty in his hands.

In this way, he expressed his righteousness to succeed the Han Dynasty and become the orthodox world, looking forward to the mercy of God, and protecting his dynasty from generation to generation.

Of course, Zhong Yu's belief in the content here is another matter. Just like the traversers look down on all the natives of the traversed world, even in the face of beings that are countless times stronger than themselves, they still think they are inferior to themselves.

What's more, as an existence that can travel through the heavens and worlds, I think that my identity is more supreme than the way of heaven, and it is extremely noble.

He also determined to put all the world under his feet and become an ant under the influence of heaven in the future. How could he submit to an ant?

It's just an expression made by Xiang Tiandao to the people of the world because of his lack of strength in the early stage! So as not to arouse their vigilance and suspicion.

The self-esteem of being a time traveler is sometimes so inexplicable, let alone Zhong Yu, who is more noble than the time traveler?

So despite all kinds of disdain and anger in his heart, Zhong Yu still suppressed the nausea in his heart, read out the sacrificial oration, and then looked at the minister below with a calm expression.

He raised his head and motioned to the eunuch beside him to read out the thick layer of imperial decree in front of him, and read out their long-awaited reward to the ministers who were waiting eagerly below.

The first one to come down was Hanling Emperor Liu Hong, and the eunuch read out his reward, Duke Pei, who took over the seven counties of Peiguo.

Emperor Ling thanked Dade with joy, and retreated under the eunuch's signal, letting the first person enter the stage.

The second one is Sikong Wang Yun. In order to repay him for taking the lead in surrendering, Zhong Yu gave him the land of three counties and supervised the dozens of feudal states around his fiefdom.

The third is the patriarch of the Yuan clan, Situ Yuanwei, who is the representative of the world's aristocratic family. He got the land of the three counties, but he did not have the right to supervise the surrounding countries to prevent his power from getting further.

...

After a while of rewards, everyone got the rewards of their own status and status, and they all went back to their homes satisfied to celebrate this joy.

And Zhong Yu was also tired all day, and returned to his bedroom exhaustedly, fell asleep, and the troubled day ended like this, and fell asleep with everyone's joy.

On the second day, each of them was received by the ministers of the feudal kingdom in the main hall, thanking Zhong Yu for the reward, and formally expressed their allegiance and loyalty to Zhong Yu here, and guaranteed their loyalty to the imperial kingdom for generations to come.

It was another hypocritical back-and-forth, and after Zhong Yu dealt with them, he opened his mouth and said: "Although the empire is established, the world is not peaceful. I want to organize an Imperial Guard Army, recruit the world's heroes into it, and defend the world for me, and conquer injustice." !"

After finishing speaking, he paused for a while, looked at the faces and opinions of the officials in the hall at the moment, and found that someone was about to speak, and immediately said decisively:

"I'm not discussing with you, but announcing to you so that you can understand what I mean and implement it more thoroughly."
